correctness.rationale: PASS, conditional only on an explicit authentic published antecedent. On e1=e2=e3=0 modulo 3 the three Jacobian rows simplify to (1,-xi,xi²). Rank drop would put all five coordinates at roots of a quadratic, hence ≤2 values; one-value pattern cannot meet e1 unless zero; for multiplicities 1/4 e2 excludes nonzero and for 2/3 e3 excludes the only e1,e2 pattern. Therefore smooth complete intersection special fiber, and degree-6 (1,2,3) curve has genus four. Direct F3 count: e1=e2 force exactly three nonzero coordinates, whose sum 0 entails all three equal, giving e3≠0. Braden–Disney-Hogg Proposition 4.5 supplies J_Q∼(50a)^4 and E has good reduction at 3; good reduction plus isogeny gives Frobenius fourth power, and #F3=0 implies elliptic a3=1. Hence numerator (1-T+3T²)^4 and ordinarity (a3 not divisible by 3). Independent direct projective enumerations over F3 and F9 yield 0 and 30; independent Hasse–Witt coefficient extraction over F3 yields I4, agreeing with ordinary. The Q-isogeny is deliberately imported, not proved by finite counts.
